items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 4: Time not on Michigan's side
items.description: After a controversial last-second win earlier in the season, the tables were turned on the Wolverines.

items.headline: CUSA matchup features New Mexico State against Western Kentucky
items.description: Western Kentucky (1-3) at New Mexico State (1-3), Oct. 1 at 8 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: New Mexico beats New Mexico State 42-18 in the 116th edition of the Rio Grande Rivalry
items.description: — Toa Fa’avae passed for 174 yards and added 57 on the ground, Scottre Humphrey rushed for 98 yards and two touchdowns, and New Mexico beat New Mexico State 42-18 on Saturday in the 116th edition of the Rio Grande Rivalry.

items.headline: New Mexico hits the road to match up against New Mexico State
items.description: New Mexico (2-1) at New Mexico State (1-2), Sept. 26 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Rice's 2 rushing TDs help Hawaii beat New Mexico State 29-19
items.description: — DeVon Rice had two rushing touchdowns, Tama Uiliata had 10 receptions for 107 yards and threw a 7-yard touchdown pass to cap the scoring, and Hawaii beat New Mexico State 29-19 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Hawaii squares off against New Mexico State
items.description: New Mexico State (1-1) at Hawaii (0-2), Sept. 12 at 11:59 p.m. EDT.
